# Jesus on the Cross (Luke 23:34)

## Emotional Focus
Jesus loved us so much He gave His life.

## Key KJV
“Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.” (Luke 23:34)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus died on the cross for our sins. Even while He was hurting He prayed for the people who hurt Him.

## Coloring Prompt
